scripts.title: BHRM5 OPERATOR TOOL 2.1 Silent aim
scripts.features:
features
- Wall ESP — every hostile gets a vis-box on the head plus a live distance tag. Boxes update in real time: green means a clear bullet path, red means cover between you and him. Round-robin visibility pass, no target starvation, no fps hit.
- Silent Aim — FOV 140 lock that never snaps your camera. Refreshes at 33Hz against live target positions so moving NPCs are tracked in real time. Sticky target logic stops crosshair flicker. Head / Root aim switchable in the UI.
- Aggressive Wallbang — spawns the round 0.5m from his skull and skips all cover, regardless of wall thickness. Works seamstessly with Silent Aim; spread cone at that distance is ~0, so every shot lands.
- No Recoil + No Spread — recoil killed at the source (impulse null), spread zeroed per-shot with instant restore. No weapons jam, no camera freeze, reload stays functional.
- Fullbright — kills shadows and fog, near-daylight visibility.
- Smart target priority — a visible target always beats a walled one; walled targets only get engaged when wallbang is on. Other NPCs' bodies never count as walls.
- Self-protection — auto-detects your own third-person body and never locks it. Crosshair eats enemies, not your own skull.
- Live HUD — active-feature pill, target count, FPS counter.
- UI — click-drag anywhere, minimize, INSERT to toggle visibility, one-tap UNLOAD restores everything clean.
what's new in v2.3
- rebuilt spread handling — the old gun-jam on fire is gone
- recoil now killed via impulse null only — no camera freeze, no stuck reloads
- better vis-aim sync — ESP color now matches exactly what aim will lock
- faster, lighter core; rapid-fire and big-mag removed for stability
usage
load with your executor in PVE mode. paste, pick a mode, toggle features. INSERT hides the panel.
PVP tease (save for the next update)
PVP build is in active development — real-player targeting on the same core. follow for release when it drops.

local function getDateInfo()
	local d=os.date("*t")

		return "--:--:--","Fecha no disponible"

	local timeText=string.format(
		"%02d:%02d:%02d",
		d.hour,
		d.min,
		d.sec

		"%s, %d de %s de %d",
		Days[d.wday] or "",
		d.day,
		Months[d.month] or "",
		d.year
	)

	return timeText,dateText
end

local LastAttacker=nil
local LastHealth=nil

local function findAttacker()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,18

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if r then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function findClosestPlayer()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,math.huge

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local h=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			if r and h and h.Health>0 then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function connectCharacter(char)
	local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	LastHealth=hum.Health

	hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
		if h<LastHealth then
			local attacker=findAttacker()

			if attacker then
				LastAttacker=attacker
			end
		end

		LastHealth=h
	end)
end

if Player.Character then
	connectCharacter(Player.Character)
end

	LastAttacker=nil
	connectCharacter(char)
end)

local events=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("events")
local SlapQueue=events:WaitForChild("SlapQueue")
local SendSlap=events:WaitForChild("SendSlap")
local DodgeEvent=events:WaitForChild("Dodge")

local SlapPower=.99927914142609
local QueueWaiting=false
local LastSlapTime=0
local SlapCooldown=.20

local function requestOneSlap()
	if not AutoSlap or QueueWaiting then
		return
	end

	QueueWaiting=true

	pcall(function()
		SlapQueue:FireServer()
	end)
end

local function sendOneSlap()
	if not AutoSlap or not QueueWaiting then
		return
	end

	QueueWaiting=false

	local now=os.clock()

	if now-LastSlapTime<SlapCooldown then
		return
	end

	LastSlapTime=now

	pcall(function()
		SendSlap:FireServer(SlapPower)
	end)
end

SlapQueue.OnClientEvent:Connect(sendOneSlap)

	or input.UserInputType==Enum.MouseMovement then

		local delta=input.Position-dragStart

		Main.Position=UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset+delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset+delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

	if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	or input.UserInputType==Enum.MouseButton1 then

		dragging=false
	end
end)

	end

--------------------------------------------------
-- FPS / RAM / PING / COORDENADAS
--------------------------------------------------

local frames=0
local fps=0
local lastTime=os.clock()
local statTimer=0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	frames+=1

	local now=os.clock()

	if now-lastTime>=.5 then
		fps=math.floor(
			frames/(now-lastTime)
		)

		frames=0
		lastTime=now
	end

	statTimer+=dt

	if statTimer>=.15 then
		statTimer=0

		local ping=math.floor(
			Player:GetNetworkPing()*1000+.5
		)

		local ram=math.floor(
			StatsService:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()
		)

		local char=Player.Character
		local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if root then
			local p=root.Position

			Info.Text=string.format(
				"FPS: %d | RAM: %d MB | Ping: %d ms\nX: %.1f  Y: %.1f  Z: %.1f",
				fps,
				ram,
				ping,
				p.X,
				p.Y,
				p.Z
			)
		else
			Info.Text=string.format(
				"FPS: %d | RAM: %d MB | Ping: %d ms\nX: --  Y: --  Z: --",
				fps,
				ram,
				ping
			)
		end
	end
end)

	if not GUI.Parent then
		return
	end

	Notice.Visible=true

	if Animations then
		tw(Notice,.35,{
			Position=UDim2.new(.5,-140,0,15)
		}):Play()
	else
		Notice.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-140,0,15)
	end

	pcall(function()

	end)

	task.wait(7)

	if Notice.Parent then
		if Animations then
			local t=tw(Notice,.35,{
				Position=UDim2.new(.5,-140,0,-90)
			})

			t:Play()
			t.Completed:Wait()
		else
			Notice.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-140,0,-90)
		end

		Notice.Visible=false
	end
end

task.spawn(function()

		end
	end
